attack-tables-lookup-hint: Choose a table, an armor type and a roll
base-list-limit-hint: Base lists of the profession a character can develop as base; the rest are developed as closed. Empty: no limit.
base-list-limit-value: {{count}} Base lists; the rest are developed as closed lists
culture-development-cost-warning: Above the usual {{limit}} DP of a culture
culture-languages-help: Languages offered by the culture. Leave empty to offer all of them
enumeration-key-help: Derived from the name: the identifier other entities store. It cannot change.
fighting-styles-help: Each style is a specialization of its skill. Ranks of the style buy its abilities at the cost shown; unallocated ranks give +2 OB each (at most +10) while fighting in the style.
maneuver-base-note-action-points: {{value}} per action point spent below the maximum ({{max}}).
maneuver-base-note-intro: Besides the modifiers above, the combat assistant applies these on its own to a maneuver with this skill:
maneuver-base-note-movement: Armor maneuver penalty and encumbrance penalty, because the maneuver involves movement.
maneuver-base-note-penalties: The character's current penalties (hit points, stun, criticals, fatigue).
maneuver-base-note-unskilled: {{value}} when the character has no ranks in the skill.
maneuver-roll-hint: Enter the roll to see the result.
maneuver-skill-hint: Choose a skill to see its maneuver profile, its modifiers and its example difficulties.
no-skill-modifiers: This skill has no catalog modifiers.
race-copy-help: A race of yours with all the data of this one will be created in the chosen realm.
race-list-limit: Only the first {{max}} races are shown: narrow the filters.
resistance-roll-empty: Enter both levels and the roll to see the result.
resistance-roll-help: Total = open-ended roll + 2 × target level − 2 × attack level + other modifiers. A total of 50 or more resists; below it, the failure is 50 minus the total and sets its degree.
resistance-roll-resisted: The total reaches {{total}}: the target resists.
select-realm-to-continue: Select the realm the new race will belong to.
skills-grouped-page-only: Grouping covers the current page only
this-skill-has-no-associated-description: This skill has no associated description.
unskilled-maneuver-hint: A character without ranks in this skill rolls the maneuver with this bonus
